inputs.note: the source's own account of its loops: every loop, run and cycle added up, moonshots and the verification loop included; read for its counts, times and estimated usage, never a loop's instruction text
one per session in the index; a missing one leaves that session's calls out, counted in coverage
a feature loop's run record: markdown, read for its header, its cycle lines and how it ended, never its prose

an example's own result, one per catalog entry with a folder: read for the existing tests' task and the tests that failed, the first counterexample, a trace's invariant, length and actions, the attempt's seconds and the checker's name; never its code, logs or paths. Each is listed among the snapshot's inputs with its own SHA-256

housekeeping.note: Changes whose summary line is one of these are trace-publication housekeeping: counted, and kept identifiable, never mixed with feature work.
